about_the_game:
Disclaimer: This game is purely for entertainment purposes. Please do not take it too seriously or relate it to real life. The in-game worldview and story are entirely fictional. Any resemblance to reality is purely coincidental.

Note: This game contains numerous rhythm game-specific terms and may not be suitable for non-rhythm game players. It is intended purely for fun. We recommend approaching it with a lighthearted mindset and avoiding excessive immersion. Player discretion is advised.

Subsequent content may include elements of psychological horror, abstraction, grotesquery, terror, and the uncanny. Proceed with caution.

Join our official QQ group for community feedback: 1043985742

Game Background

In 20xx, arcade rhythm games began gaining popularity in small towns.
Liu Xiazhe, who became obsessed with rhythm games only to have his tablet destroyed by his family, moved alone to a small town for school. There, he struggled to find classmates who shared his passion. He longed for companions—or even a partner—with similar interests...

During his second year of high school, when Liu Xiazhe discovered an arcade rhythm game: "wumeng dx".
From then on, his life became intertwined with four rhythm game-obsessed girls, each with distinct personalities...

Game Features

  • A rhythm game-themed narrative inspired by real-life experiences, tailored specifically for the rhythm gaming community.

  • Player-driven endings with multiple branching paths, including:
    Take medicine Route / Transsexual Route / UP Master Route / Dance God Route
    ...designed to authentically reflect the community’s unique culture.

short_description: "Love wmc" is a visual novel game based on music games. It tells a series of stories about the protagonist who came to a small county town to study alone due to family conflicts, and accidentally got involved with four female protagonists because of an arcade music game.
